title: BUGFIX — Wire post-queue purge into cleanup-pipeline-runs.ts
rationale: Sprint 1477 revealed: cleanup-pipeline-runs.ts deletes video files but post-queue.jsonl still references them (30/36 stale entries). Fix: after cleanup-pipeline-runs.ts deletes files from a run dir, immediately purge post-queue.jsonl entries whose files no longer exist. Inline the purge logic (don't call queue-purge-stale.ts as a subprocess — copy the logic directly). Also run a one-time purge now to clean the existing 30 stale entries.
outputs: scripts/scs001/cleanup-pipeline-runs.ts (modified — inline queue purge after file deletion)
success_criteria: cleanup-pipeline-runs.ts --dry-run shows: X files to delete + Y queue entries to purge
cleanup-pipeline-runs.ts live run deletes files AND removes matching queue entries in one pass
queue-purge-stale.ts --dry-run shows 0 stale after cleanup runs

tasks.description: Modify scripts/scs001/cleanup-pipeline-runs.ts: after deleting video files from run dirs, read workspace/scs001/post-queue.jsonl (if it exists), filter out any pending entry whose file no longer exists on disk, write the filtered queue back. Log how many entries were purged. Also add --dry-run support for the queue purge step (show what would be purged without writing). Keep the change surgical — add ~20 lines to the existing cleanup script.
